what: Netflix is the largest paid streaming service, with more than 300 million subscribers in over 190 countries, offering series, films, games and live events.
customers: Households worldwide that pay a monthly subscription; advertisers on the cheaper ad-supported plan.
money: monthly plans in the US, Europe, Latin America and Asia
moat: Global scale that lets it spend more on content per subscriber than rivals, a strong recommendation engine and brand.
risks: Slower subscriber growth in mature markets
Competition for viewing time from YouTube and social media
opportunities: Revenue grew about 16% last year with a 29% operating margin
Its advertising tier adds revenue from subscribers paying less, which raises total revenue per household
Analysts see about 43% upside from current levels
watch: Revenue growth per region and advertising revenue scale.
